# The Fabulous Scientist

> > A creative blend of earth science expertise, artistic expression, and personal storytelling by geologist and artist Grass Padrique, featuring professional portfolios, handcrafted art, science advocacy, and lifestyle reflections.

The Fabulous Scientist is the personal website of Grass Padrique, a geologist, science writer, and watercolor artist based in the Philippines. The site combines professional geology work with creative pursuits, science education advocacy, and personal essays on topics ranging from fountain pens to hydroponic gardening.

## Key Topics

- Grass Padrique
- Earth Science & Geology
- Art & Watercolor
- Fountain Pens
- Writing Instruments
- Science Education
- Product Reviews
- Personal Essays
- Productivity & Planning
- Travel & Lifestyle
- Philippines
- UP Diliman
- Hydroponic Gardening
- Pen Collection
- Science Advocacy

- [Discover the Hongdian M2: A Pocket Pen Review – The Fabulous Scientist](https://thefabulousscientist.com/2026/02/09/discover-the-hongdian-m2-a-pocket-pen-review): Review and comparison of Hongdian M2 pocket fountain pen
